profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | 15+ Years | Full Stack | AI/ML
profile.summary:
Full Stack Software Engineer with 15+ years designing, building, and scaling production web applications end to end, paired with deep, hands-on experience bringing AI/ML into real systems. 

I ship ML-driven features for millions of users — integrating models into real-time inference pipelines, building LLM-powered chatbots and conversational interfaces, and operationalizing data science experiments into monitored, reliable services.

Fluent across modern front ends, robust back-end services, cloud infrastructure, and API design, with a track record of clean, maintainable code, mentoring engineers, and delivering measurable business impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Streamlined student-services workflows by delivering internal web applications now used daily by district staff across multiple schools, cutting manual processing time. Built with React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
• Eliminated error-prone manual data handoffs by building API integrations between legacy education systems and modern interfaces, improving data accuracy.
• Shipped reliable, accessible tools by partnering closely with non-technical stakeholders to turn operational needs into well-tested software.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · JavaScript · Software Design · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · Front-end Development · Web Service Development · Node.js · TensorFlow · React.js · Full-Stack Development · Software Development · Next.js · JavaScript Libraries

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Launched customer-facing financial features for millions of users that improved engagement and retention, built across the stack with React, TypeScript, and Java/Spring.
• Reduced fraudulent transactions and improved personalization by shipping ML-driven features, integrating models into real-time inference pipelines on AWS.
• Cut key page load times by roughly 40% by optimizing front-end rendering and back-end queries, measurably improving the customer experience.
• Accelerated model-to-production delivery by partnering with data science to operationalize experiments into monitored, reliable production services.
• Raised release reliability and code quality across the team by establishing code review, automated testing, and CI/CD standards.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved checkout reliability and conversion by leading e-commerce feature development across the full stack with React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
• Scaled high-volume B2B order processing by architecting resilient microservices and REST APIs.
• Cut front-end development time and improved consistency by building a reusable component library and establishing best practices.
• Increased team velocity by mentoring junior engineers and leading code reviews.

• Designed conversational flows and the REST and GraphQL APIs powering the chatbot and supporting internal tools.
• Delivered features on tight deadlines within agile teams while upholding Apple's high quality and accessibility standards.
